name: Layered Coffee Tonic
flavor_notes: A layered coffee tonic — bittersweet coffee poured over chilled tonic water with a lemon note.

preparations.roast_note: Same tonic pairing as Grapefruit Coffee Tonic — a bright roast works with the citrus note instead of against it.

ingredients.item: Cometeer capsule, fully melted and cooled
ingredients.notes: stands in for a 1 oz espresso, not a Vertuo 2.7 oz double

steps: Melt the capsule ahead of time; keep it cold.
Fill a tall glass with ice and pour in the tonic.
Slowly pour the melted coffee over the back of a spoon so it layers on top.
Garnish with lemon peel; stir only if you want it mixed.
